text:
Situation: Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation of manufacture with an initial posting date of 2026-04-08. Corvale East holds 94 vials of fosaprepitant dimeglumine 150 mg/5 mL at 8.3 vials per day, providing 11.3 days on hand. Corvale General holds 166 vials at 8.9 vials per day, providing 18.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows fosaprepitant dimeglumine is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 11 to 19 days depending on site. The Fresenius Kabi discontinuation may affect contracted supply. Alternate manufacturers AVYXA Pharma, LLC, Actavis Pharma, Inc., Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Avenacy, LLC, and BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no plant we could place. A registered plant for a NorthStar Rx LLC label is Aspiro Pharma Limited (FEI 3014483338) in India, last inspected 2023-08-11 with a VAI classification.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify whether the Fresenius Kabi discontinuation affects contracted supply and confirm availability from AVYXA Pharma, LLC or other alternate manufacturers. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer to evaluate alternate manufacturers ranked 1 through 5 for supply reliability and lead time. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA's drug shortage list daily for any status change. Approval: Pharmacy Director.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose substitutions at this time.
